control-identity-receipt.json.scope: Separate immutable uninstrumented6c83 DSP parameter-only binary; all configured bank fields and independently recomputed fresh requested targets text-exact to observer shadow in115 public-event cells. No process/PCM test claimed.

final-manifest.json.scope: Prospective numerical-only115-cell hypothesis; no process/PCM, source/default/test changes or candidate promotion. All frozen-open coefficients positive; per-cell negative solves are diagnostic only.

first-order-shelf-rejection.json.derivation: O=tan(w/2); center=sqrt(O0*Oh); r=O0/Oh; R=Mh/M0; q=(R-r)/(1-R*r); |S(O0)|²=(1+r*q)/(1+r/q); requiredG=M0/|S(O0)|. All4 examples exceed unity; scalar clipping silently changes H1.
first-order-shelf-rejection.json.scope: First-order same-anchor geometric-mean-center shelf rejected analytically before physical-loss protocol; numeric values first computed and sent to root before protocol freeze, standalone packaging now. No audio or Source edit.
first-order-shelf-rejection.json.verdict: Reject specified fixed-center passive candidate; no audio experiment.

actual_export.baseline_modes: Configured fixed-bank coupled complex poles H1-H3 including actual cubic read, AP8, onepole, material/correction sections, loop gain and polarization coupling; exclude separate active Contact choke/excitation and output pickup. Not whole evolving audio modal analysis.
actual_export.geometry: Current voice configured B, live T, Z (mu=Z²/T), physical L, outer string diameter from production spec/gauge. Keep empirical/clamped B distinct from independent unclamped EI geometry.
actual_export.targets: Capture actual post-clamp t60Fundamental/t60HighTarget at configureVoiceDamping configureLoop for both axes; retain intrinsic pre-hand targets too. No copied target schedule replaces captured values.

grid.allocation: public setSoloStringMask(1<<physicalString), then public noteOn(openNote+fret); one new engine per cell, no process/audio output
grid.other_controls: applyGuitarBuild(defaultGuitarBuild) and public defaults, except bodyResonance,artifactAmount,pickNoise,fingerNoise,releaseNoise,sympatheticAmount,palmMute set0; Sustain/downstroke; no hand

physical_model.air: rho_air=1.2 kg/m³, eta_air=1.8e-5 Pa*s, outer diameter d; RL=2*pi*eta+2*pi*d*sqrt(pi*eta*rho*f); alpha_air=RL/(2*mu), identical on both axes.
physical_model.anchors: Use actual requested fresh vertical intrinsic fundamental and fHigh targets, not actual output envelopes or realized fixed-bank modal T60. At the requested f0 and fHigh solve stiff n(f) and subtract air before the exact2x2 solve.
physical_model.comparison: For all115 cells predict physical mode1/2/3 and fHigh decay using frozen open coefficients and compare requested anchors, actual fixed-bank modes and per-note-implied parameters. Keep coordinate/frequency differences explicit.
physical_model.dispersion: omega_n=(pi*c/L)*n*sqrt(1+B*n²), c=sqrt(T/mu). Do not silently normalize the fundamental to erase stiffness. For target frequency invert n²+B*n⁴=(2*L*f/c)². Physical mode1 may differ slightly from written pitch; record discrepancy.
physical_model.frozen_candidate_coefficients: For each physical string solve delta_W/delta_E ONCE from fret0 vertical targets. Keep those same coefficients for every fret and both axes; do not scale air by1.7. No negative clipping, per-note replacement, residual fit or new mixture fraction.
physical_model.material: alpha_material=omega*[delta_W+delta_E*B*n²]/[2*(1+B*n²)] for complex tension T*(1+i*delta_W) and bending EI*(1+i*delta_E), weak-loss modal approximation.
physical_model.per_note_solves: Diagnostic only: report coefficients implied independently by each cell/axis and their conditioning, including all negative coefficients and normalized deviations from frozen open coefficients. They are not a candidate coefficient table.
physical_model.units: SI, frequencies Hz, omega radians/s, amplitude alpha per second, T60=ln(1000)/alpha

predeclared_checks: All115 public allocations/frets and actual controls must match plan.
All source hashes and observer-only shadow patch bound; no outputs overwritten.
Report every negative air-subtracted anchor or negative coefficient, no clipping.
Report determinant and2-norm condition number; any singular or poorly determined bending term stays visible, no invented acceptance tolerance.
Compare delta_E to cited1e-4..1e-3 context as a broad literature range, not universal pass/fail threshold.
Report implied material variation with fret/deadSpot/clamps/polarization and held-out fixed-open anchor departures; do not re-fit.
Separate physical modal rates from requested anchors and actual rational-loop poles.
No listen/production/attack/repick/refret/CPU/alias claim follows even from positive coefficients.

primary_source.sections: III-A eq9-13 for air, bending, wound complex-tension loss and amplitude decay; III-D material-loss range
unknowns: Production B is an empirical core coordinate, not measured EI.
Fresh intrinsic targets contain voiced dead-spot, clamp and polarization factors, not isolated material measurements.
Wound outer diameter/mass are model estimates; source string alloy/winding/age unknown.
Frequency-independent complex loss factors are finite-band weak-loss assumptions, not a globally causal time-domain constitutive law.

protocol.json.prior_rejected_first_order_shelf: Before this protocol: exact same low/high traversal gains and first-order pole/zero geometric center sqrt(tan(w0/2)*tan(wh/2)) require scalar gain above unity on fresh E2. No audio candidate. Algebraic rejection is retained separately.
protocol.json.scope: Numerical pre-audio falsification only. No production Source/Tests/default changes or candidate audio. Parameter export from immutable Source with an observer-only ignored shadow is allowed. No retrospective grid enlargement.

results.json.scope: No audio, no production candidate. Open coefficients fixed, all per-note solves diagnostic only. A positive solve does not identify measured material properties or qualify realtime/performance behavior.

verification-receipt.json.scope: Independent closed-form2x2 determinant solve (not numpy.linalg), equivalent air formula and stiff-frequency inversion; all115cells,230axis solves and690 exported coupled poles re-evaluated directly; production Source24 identity. Does not qualify candidate.

interpretation_addendum: All five frozen-open pairs are positive. Nineteen negative per-cell diagnostic solves are not fixed-open instability. Cited steel range is contextual, not a universal wound bound. Constant inverse-Q coordinates can include winding and dislocation contributions. The stiff-PDE denominator is a declared model extension, not verbatim Pate eq11.

portable_provenance_note.normalization: Only five repository-root prefixes in the uninstrumented-control compiler command are replaced with dot. All numeric/protocol/result/parameter values unchanged; original input byte identities remain recorded.
